# galaxy

The Scalar Galaxy is an example OpenAPI document to test OpenAPI tools and libraries. It's a fictional universe with fictional planets and fictional data.

## Resources

* https://github.com/scalar/scalar
* https://github.com/OAI/OpenAPI-Specification
* https://scalar.com

## Markdown Support

## Install

Homebrew 6 requires third-party taps to be trusted before first install:

```sh
brew tap --trust oxmonty/tap
brew install oxmonty/tap/galaxy-cli
```

Installing with the fully-qualified form (`brew install oxmonty/tap/galaxy-cli`) skips the trust prompt.

From source:

```sh
go install github.com/oxmonty/galaxy-cli/cmd/galaxy@latest
```

## Usage

```sh
galaxy --help
galaxy auth token create
```

## Exit codes

| Code | Meaning |
| ---- | ------- |
| 0 | Success |
| 1 | Internal error |
| 2 | Usage error (bad flags/arguments) |
| 3 | Auth failure (HTTP 401/403) |
| 4 | Other 4xx API error |
| 5 | 5xx API error |
| 6 | Network/transport error |

## Upgrade

```sh
galaxy upgrade
```

## Shell completions

```sh
galaxy completion bash|zsh|fish|powershell
```
